interface.alias_and_mutation_notes: Caller supplies out[M,3584], which is written and returned. Atomic mode requires zero initialization; reduce mode writes per-slot intermediates then reduces.

contracts.value: aiter FlyDSL fused MoE stage-2: per-expert down-projection GEMM (afp8 act x mxfp4 w2 -> bf16) over the sorted (token,slot) pairs, plus the top-16 expert combine. Both hot kernels (mfma_moe2_..._cshuffle_t64x256x128_..._acc0 and moe_reduction_kernel_plain_bf16_topk16_md3584) execute inside this ONE call, which is why the call is the timed unit and the byte-reduction lever (fusing the combine into the cshuffle epilogue) is expressible without touching the seam.
